newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU publishes grain intervention changes.
newsitem.headline: EU publishes grain intervention changes.

text.p: The European Union published changes to rules under which intervention agencies accept cereals into public stores.
In Friday's EU Official Journal, EU regulation 689/92 was changed to allow cereals with a maximum moisture content of 15 percent, except for maize and sorghum, into intervention stores.
Greece was allowed to accept durum wheat containing 14 percent sub-standard grain.
Barley with a specific weight of less than 64 kg/hl will not be penalised.
The intervention measures, which were approved earlier by the EU cereals management committee, are backdated to July 1, 1995.
